about.bio: I’m a second-year Economics and Finance student at Queen Mary University of London, originally from Newcastle. Alongside my degree I work part-time as a Junior Associate at Zaltek Digital, where I’ve worked since 2022. I write about economics and markets here, and I build data and finance projects in Python and TypeScript, all of which are open on GitHub.
